original: Flour and water, kneaded. Fries into flatbread.
English: Flour and water, kneaded. Fries into flatbread.
German: Mehl und Wasser, geknetet. Wird in der Pfanne zu Fladenbrot.

original: Risen dough. Bake it into bread.
English: Risen dough. Bake it into bread.

original: Rolled out dough. Cut it into pasta.
English: Rolled out dough. Cut it into pasta.

original: Fresh pasta. Cooks fast, keeps badly.
English: Fresh pasta. Cooks fast, keeps badly.
German: Frische Nudeln. Kochen schnell, halten schlecht.

original: Dried on a rack. Keeps for a long time.
English: Dried on a rack. Keeps for a long time.
German: Auf dem Trockenrahmen getrocknet. Haelt lange.
